message: Compass: reorganization as a catalyst for Cosan's deleveraging and value creation (M&A pitch, March 2026).
layout_trick: Dark black-to-red gradient with centered logo, a thin horizontal rule and a one-line thesis subtitle; team credits anchored bottom-left in small type.

message: Agenda in five sections: Cosan overview, Compass and IPO, PN conversion, follow-on and spin-off, holding discount reduction.
layout_trick: Five full-width dark-red bars with roman numerals and a diamond-ended hairline, evenly stacked on the gradient background.

message: Cosan is a capital allocator holding Raizen, Rumo, Compass, Moove and Radar with limited cross-asset synergies.
layout_trick: At-a-glance in three zones: text box with key-financials table (left), holding tree with ownership % per subsidiary logo (center), and stacked dividend-source bars plus a share-price line annotated with event callouts below.

message: The Vale stake (4.9%) led to a BRL 7.5bn loss and forced deleveraging, with interest paid exceeding dividends received.
layout_trick: Price line with shaded entry-to-exit band, a loss-breakdown waterfall in a green-outlined box below, and interest vs dividends bars with a Selic line overlay on the right.

message: High leverage forced Cosan into a BTG-led equity injection at the lowest share price in ten years; interest burden consumes most dividends received.
layout_trick: Two-panel dashboard (line charts with dual axis, net-debt waterfall) with a pull-quote box and a horizontal-bar strip showing interest/dividends ratio 136%, 128%, 117%.

message: Post-transaction board shows gradual dissociation of the holding structure, with headcount and G&A falling.
layout_trick: Board drawn as a 3D boardroom table with named seats and independent/member roles, plus meeting photos with an executive quote next to a G&A bar chart with headcount line.

message: Cosan's market cap decomposes into Compass, Rumo, Radar, Moove and Raizen minus net debt, implying a holding discount versus NAV.
layout_trick: SOTP-style waterfall of asset values that steps down to net debt and then NAV, with the implied discount bracketed against market cap.

message: Compass dominates Brazil's piped gas distribution: concessions across states, EBITDA BRL 5.0bn and 7 concessions.
layout_trick: Red-tinted Brazil map with concession logos and volume labels pointing to each state, flanked by a key-financials table and stacked consumer-class bars.

message: Brazil is resource-rich but downstream-poor in gas: about 60% of production is rejected/reinjected, with few connected customers per inhabitant.
layout_trick: Large area chart of production vs reinjection with a red callout box quantifying the 50% rejected, paired with small-multiple bars for connections per country.

message: Compass runs a proven playbook (Comgas market opening) and replicates it in the Edge platform, with growing volumes by segment.
layout_trick: Before/after regulatory table by dimension next to dumbbell scales for ResCom penetration, opex/customer and margin, comparing Comgas 2012 vs 2025 and the comparable peer.

message: PASS3 IPO priced at BRL 28.00, BRL 20bn equity value, BRL 3.2bn proceeds, 16% free float, 5.9x EV/EBITDA.
layout_trick: Four giant KPI numbers in a row under an Offer Overview header, then a pre/post-offer ownership table with red key-insight callouts connected by lines on the right.

message: After a 56-month IPO drought, PASS3 reopened the window but scarred investors forced a low-end pricing despite returning foreign demand.
layout_trick: Annual IPO count bars with a red-bracketed drought period and annotated explanations, plus a final bar showing price range with the chosen price circled at the low end.

message: Compass implied equity value of BRL 24bn is a 21% premium to the IPO price, so Cosan is positioned to capture the gap; implied BRL 33.78 vs BRL 28.00 per share.
layout_trick: Football field on the left with min/max labels at each bar end and an average line, a red-scale heatmap of equity value vs growth and fulfillment on the right, and a boxed comparison of implied vs IPO price underneath.

message: Even after debt pre-payment, holdco leverage remains high; coverage of net financial expenses by dividends is still below 1.0x.
layout_trick: Holdco debt table with pre/post-IPO columns and the expected net debt circled, a waterfall from gross debt to adjusted net debt, and paired bars with coverage-ratio tags.

message: Two moves, one outcome: PN conversion and Compass spin-off bring Cosan's expanded net debt to zero.
layout_trick: Two numbered statements on a dark slide; the build highlights one step while the other dims, reused across multiple slides as a progress divider.

message: Cosan Dez preferred shares function as quasi-debt; converting them to Compass ON removes BRL 3.8bn from expanded net debt.
layout_trick: Debt-structure table with a highlighted row on the left and a Step 1/Step 2 conversion flow of shareholder logos with ownership % on the right, with a shareholder agreement box below.

message: Conversion premium and Compass equity value drive the upside to preferred holders; expanded net debt falls to BRL 3,575mm.
layout_trick: Red-gradient heatmap of conversion premium vs Compass equity value next to the Step 2 flowchart, with the debt table's post-conversion column circled.

message: Compass is spun off to Cosan shareholders, establishing direct ownership while enabling deleveraging.
layout_trick: Before and after structure charts side by side (arrow in between) with shareholder logo boxes, ownership % on the lines, and a two-column Step 1/Step 2 overview with value-impact (+/-) bullets underneath.

message: BRL 4.5bn follow-on is sized to fully prepay Cosan's residual net debt, with poison pill and lock-up protecting new shareholders.
layout_trick: Offer terms box with conditions and a small build-up bar chart of the offer size, next to the structure chart with the sale path flagged by a dashed arrow.

message: Debt reduction from IPO proceeds, PN conversion and the Compass secondary sale takes holdco net debt from BRL 9.9bn to zero.
layout_trick: Waterfall of net debt to zero with the final bar shaded in a gradient and a text-box explaining the cash allocation, paired with the structure chart.

message: BTG builds control of Compass in three steps (preferred conversion, spin-off, follow-on), reaching 18.7% direct ownership.
layout_trick: Cap table with Delta column outlined in dashed red and the BTG row highlighted, next to the pro-forma structure chart and a three-step strip at the bottom.

message: If Compass trades at IPO price or above, holdco discount falls from 37% to 14% and shareholders gain; MOIC 1.28x in the football-field average scenario.
layout_trick: Scatter of holding discount vs dividends ratio with fitted line and circled 2022/2025 clusters, a formula table, and stacked-bar value creation with a MOIC heatmap (discount vs offer discount).

message: At the lower IPO price scenario (equity BRL 20bn), the structure still delivers positive upside, with MOIC 1.17x.
layout_trick: Same template as the average scenario page for direct comparison, with a title banner (scenario name, equity value, MOIC) over a boxed bar chart and heatmap with the base cell outlined.

message: BTG's Compass bet turns the reorganization into a 1.33x MOIC value creation with direct exposure to a long-term infrastructure platform.
layout_trick: Timeline of deal milestones above a waterfall from invested capital to total equity with a circled MOIC badge, next to a logo constellation of BTG's infra portfolio on a time axis and a quote with photo.

message: Stepping back: stake in Compass, holding discount, adjusted net debt and interest reduction at each stage from post-IPO to pro forma.
layout_trick: Three stacked KPI strips with four big numbers each, where the active stage is highlighted and the others dimmed, synced with the structure chart on the right.

message: A BRL 7.4bn holdco debt ends with a clean balance sheet and Compass freed from a holding structure; before and after structure side by side.
layout_trick: Current vs pro forma structure charts side by side with a chevron between them and a closing red-keyword summary box below.
